_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (group html_a), 2026-11-25, under Sam's ask in session S730: the catalog's printed heading for each course subject code, for the local subject titles that decide each code's common subject (ruling r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Glendale's online catalog is a Coursedog app; its PDF catalog prints each subject's heading above its first course description (pages 98 on, glendale_course_desc_*.json). This read lists the catalogs page's PDF links (shown, not followed) and prints only the lines above each subject's first course in the PDF, as el_camino_subject_headings.json does. Two loads, no model call.

questions.catalogs: Which catalog PDFs the catalogs page links, so the newest is the one read.
questions.subject_headings: The subject heading the catalog prints above each subject's first course.
